LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_thunder: Discharge A power chain sustains the enemies. Counter the feeder with the existing focus-fire or control answers. Linked living enemies have 1.25x ordinary attack cooldowns for 8 seconds. Ignoring the feeder forfeits the group slowdown.
LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_flame: Cleanse Embers constrain movement. Bait a locked impact into an old ember. Clear all embers; this caster's next legal attack deals its normal damage without creating embers, once before phase end. Control alone does not earn the cleanse.
LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_blood: Fatigue Frenzy makes ordinary attacks dangerous. Apply effective control during frenzy, or deal a further 20% of maximum torso health in actual damage after it starts. End frenzy early; for 8 seconds movement is 0.8x and ordinary attack cooldown is 1.25x. Waiting out frenzy remains viable but earns no fatigue.
LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_titan: Damaged regroup Nearby stationary enemies form a defensive formation. Pull an established formation apart; a solo enemy braces its own position and can be pulled away. Damage and control retain their original rewards. Former members must stand still for 4 seconds to reform; that phase has at most 10% formation defense. The opportunity expires at the end of the next phase. Damage or control alone does not damage regrouping.
LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_frost: Early thaw Frozen enemies have defense and slower movement. Deal 20% of maximum torso health in actual damage while frozen. Thaw that enemy early for 8 seconds with 25% exposure; then restore its current phase state without restarting the group cycle. Saving burst for the natural thaw remains effective.
LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_blade: Linked stance breach Complementary facings defend frontal approaches. Land an actual side or rear hit that breaks a stance. The complementary stance enemy is also exposed for 8 seconds; a solo enemy cannot rearm for the first 8 seconds of its next phase. Frontal damage and control remain viable but do not earn the linked breach.
LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_marksman: Force relocation The shooter occupies a safe firing position. Keep the protected target behind effective cover from this shooter for 3 continuous seconds. The shooter relocates and cannot start specials until arrival or 8 seconds; without a legal destination, it pauses in place for 8 seconds. Leaving effective cover resets the 3-second count; ordinary attacks remain dangerous.
LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_spirit: Pact exhaustion Living enemies can rebuild a pact in a later phase. Within the same phase and 8 seconds after pact break, deal a further 20% of maximum torso health in actual damage to the original primary; phase transition closes unearned follow-up opportunities. That enemy cannot regain pact protection during the first 8 seconds of its next phase; roles still rotate normally. Insufficient window damage only earns the original pact break; dead enemies never return.
LanguageData.RHA_Refine_Brief_guardian: Protected respite The protected target is under encounter pressure. Meet the original shared threshold through applicant damage, effective healing or actual shield absorption. For 8 seconds, encounter enemies deal 20% less ordinary attack damage to that target; solo play protects yourself without generating support credit. Ordinary attacks still occur and the original survival requirement remains.
